q: How are emissions counted at a coal tar pitch distillation plant?
title: Coal tar pitch distillation emissions
short: Coal tar from coke ovens is heated in a fired still and split into pitch, oils and naphthalene. The furnace fuel is Scope 1. The tar arrives as a by-product, so ask the coke maker how it allocates emissions to it. Anode and graphite electrode makers buy the pitch.
audience: Tar distillers and buyers of binder pitch

ul: Fuel for the tar still furnace.
Electricity for pumps and pitch handling.

p: Coke oven emissions belong to the coke maker. A share reaches the tar only if the coke maker allocates some to it. Record which approach your supplier used.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
